description: Airbus A340-311 delivered new to Turkish Airlines in 1994 as Ankara, later renamed Malazgirt and retired in March 2015. Dismantled in 2016, moved to Cayirova on fourteen trucks in 2018 and reassembled as the structure of the UcakPark aviation science centre. Gutted by fire on the afternoon of 5 September 2026, with the tail section collapsing onto a fire engine; no injuries. The cause is under investigation and no decision on repair or scrapping has been announced, so the airframe is recorded as retained on site but no longer presented.
